description: Source code for PostgresRecordManager class and related logic, implementing a record management interface with database schema creation, key operations, and connection handling.

classes.name: PostgresRecordManager_RecordManager
classes.description: Implements INode interface; manages configuration and initialization of Postgres record manager.

classes.name: PostgresRecordManager
classes.description: Implements RecordManagerInterface; handles database schema creation, key existence checks, listing, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the record manager with credentials, connection options, and configuration based on node data.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates the table name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Creates and initializes a TypeORM DataSource for database operations.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates the necessary table and indexes in the Postgres database if they do not exist.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp from the database.

methods.name: generatePlaceholderForRowAt
methods.description: Generates SQL placeholders for batch insert/update queries.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Inserts or updates records in the database with provided keys and options.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple keys in the database.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists keys with optional filters like before, after, limit, groupIds, and docId.

methods.name: deleteKeys
methods.description: Deletes specified keys from the database.
